metaDescription: Write objectives with key results and score each from start, target and current values, with objective averages. Free and private.
intro: Scores key results from start, target and current values and averages them per objective.
why:
OKRs only help when key results are measurable. Scoring each one as progress from start to target keeps the discussion about numbers. The score works for targets that go down too, like response time.

Write lines starting with O: and KR: and the tool does the math. Whether 0.7 or 1.0 counts as success depends on your team, so decide before the quarter starts.
howTo: Add KR: name | start | target | current lines.
Read scores and update the current values.

faq.a: (current - start) divided by (target - start), kept between 0 and 1.
Some teams aim for 0.7 on stretch goals. Others expect 1.0.
